description: What a domain publishes for AI agents before you touch it: ai-catalog.json (ARD), llms.txt, agents.md, and its robots.txt directives for AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended…). Includes a visibility receipt: surface-by-surface state, the words that would find the domain in search (or the honest fact that none would), what is missing and where to publish it. Served from the Desvela ARD index when fresh (<7 days), live-checked otherwise. Free.
name: preflight
title: Preflight a domain
